title: Device report v1 (POST /ingest body)
description: Task 2.4. One report = up to 192 timestamped 15-minute samples plus the latest forecast and events. Unit of record = the sample (FR-D04: 96 samples per 24 h). Ranges in x-plausible are the G1 plausible ranges (FR-D01): the server stores out-of-range samples with plausible=false instead of rejecting the batch, so the schema deliberately does not enforce them. Field names are shared with the MQTT telemetry payload (hub-mqtt.md).

v.description: Schema version. A contract change needs an ADR (role file).

sent_at.description: Device clock, unix seconds, SNTP-synced before sending. The device must not send before a successful SNTP sync (it keeps buffering). Server skew = received_at - sent_at; ts of every sample is shifted by it if |skew| > 120 s.

trigger.description: scheduled = hourly (FR-D02); critical = immediate report on a critical event (FR-E03); reconnect = first report after an offline period (FR-D04).

forecast_h.description: Model A output, hours until the dry threshold; null = no forecast yet (model has not produced one); 72.0 = 72 h or more (app shows '> 3 days'). FR-E01, UC-08.

cal.description: Device calibration points (raw ADC counts) used to compute moisture_pct. Sent whenever changed. FR-NEW-CAL in requirements-v1.0-delta.md.

ota.description: Result of the last OTA attempt, sent once (FR-D05).

samples.description: Oldest first. 4 per scheduled report; up to 96 after 24 h offline (FR-D04); more than 192 are sent in several requests.

ts.description: Sample time, unix seconds. (device_id, ts) is the idempotency key: resending a sample is harmless.

moisture_pct.description: Relative soil moisture 0-100 % between the device's dry/wet points. null = sensor failed.

moisture_raw.description: Raw ADC counts (12 bit), kept for retraining.

type.description: Critical (server sets events.critical, creates alert, pushes): wetting_unexpected, waterlogged, sensor_out_of_soil, sensor_fault. Not critical (stored, shown as 'watered' / used by tips): wetting, fast_drying. Source: edge-ai-concept 2.4 (FR-E02, FR-E03, FR-A07).
